Package org.cyclops.colossalchests2.client.render

Class RenderChestCore

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.client.render.RenderChestCore
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.client.renderer.blockentity.BlockEntityRenderer<BlockEntityChestCore>, net.neoforged.neoforge.client.extensions.IBlockEntityRendererExtension<BlockEntityChestCore>
Direct Known Subclasses:
RenderChestCoreNeoForge
public class RenderChestCore extends Object implements net.minecraft.client.renderer.blockentity.BlockEntityRenderer<BlockEntityChestCore>
Renders a formed chest as one giant vanilla-style chest whose body exactly fills the structure, followed by the IChestOverlays of its decorated members.

  • Field Details

    • OVERLAY_OFFSET

      public static final float OVERLAY_OFFSET
      How far overlays float in front of the chest surface, far enough to avoid z-fighting. The lock sticks out further, so it hides the part of an overlay right behind it, like any object in front.

      public static void applyChestTransform(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack poseStack, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos origin, ChestStructure structure, net.minecraft.core.Direction facing)
